title: Mooncake: A KVCache-centric Disaggregated Architecture for LLM Serving
authors: Ruoyu Qin; Zheming Li; Weiran He; Mingxing Zhang; Yongwei Wu; Weimin Zheng; Xinran Xu
research_focus: Long-context / Prefix cache, Multi-tenant scheduling, PD disaggregation, Continuous batching, KV cache offloading, Capacity planning, Performance modeling, Datacenter networking

problem_statement.en: LLM serving systems face challenges in maximizing throughput while meeting latency-related SLOs (TTFT and TBT) under overloaded scenarios and limited GPU resources. Traditional coupled architectures struggle with long-context requests and inefficient resource utilization.
problem_statement.zh: LLM 服務系統在過載情境與有限 GPU 資源下，難以同時兼顧吞吐量極大化與 TTFT/TBT 等延遲 SLO。傳統耦合架構在長 context 請求下表現不佳，資源利用率也偏低。

key_innovation.en: A KVCache-centric disaggregated architecture that separates prefill and decoding clusters, utilizes underutilized CPU/DRAM/SSD resources for a distributed KVCache pool, and employs a KVCache-centric scheduler with prediction-based early rejection.
key_innovation.zh: 以 KVCache 為中心的解耦合架構：將 prefill 與 decode 拆成獨立叢集，並把閒置的 CPU/DRAM/SSD 串成分散式 KVCache pool；scheduler 以 KVCache 為核心、結合預測式早期拒絕策略。

key_improvements.en: Up to 525% throughput increase in simulated scenarios; 75% more requests handled under real workloads while meeting SLOs.
key_improvements.zh: 模擬情境下吞吐量最高提升 525%；真實工作負載下在滿足 SLO 的前提下可多處理 75% 的請求。

reported_accuracy: Not Reported (system paper; scheduler uses prediction-based early rejection rather than reporting MAPE)

scope_assumptions.en: TTFT and TBT SLOs are jointly optimized via early rejection of incoming requests when KVCache pool capacity is predicted to violate latency targets; assumes RDMA fabric between prefill, decode, and KVCache pool nodes; design and validation tied to Moonshot's production Kimi traffic, may not generalize to single-tenant settings.
scope_assumptions.zh: TTFT 與 TBT SLO 透過預測式早期拒絕策略共同優化：當 KVCache pool 容量預測無法滿足延遲目標時即拒收請求；假設 prefill、decode 與 KVCache pool 節點間使用 RDMA fabric；設計與驗證綁定於 Moonshot 的 Kimi 生產流量，難以直接外推至單租戶情境。

offload_trigger: Store-everything after prefill: KVCache blocks are saved into the distributed CPU/DRAM/SSD pool as part of normal serving; there is no gap- or lifetime-based offload decision.
destination_tiers: host DRAM, local SSD, disaggregated store
prefetch_signal_timing: Cache-aware request routing rather than prefetch: the scheduler routes requests to the node holding the longest reusable prefix and imports remote KV via layer-wise streaming when transfer beats recompute; restore is decided at request admission.
agent_awareness: None agent-specific: exploits cross-request prefix reuse in a disaggregated cluster; no tool-gap timing or per-session lifetime signal.

when_to_offload_rule.en: Store all KV into the distributed pool after prefill; the operative decision is on restore — import reusable remote KV when the estimated transfer/queueing/SLO cost beats local prefill recomputation, otherwise recompute.
when_to_offload_rule.zh: prefill 完成後即將所有 KV 存入分散式 pool；實際決策在於回填端——當估計的傳輸/排隊/SLO 成本優於本地 prefill 重算時即匯入遠端可重用 KV，否則重算。
